frames.design: metres, x = east, y = north, z = up (Blender Z-up). Use this frame in Blender.
frames.bevy: metres, Y-up, north = -Z: bevy = (design.x, design.z, -design.y). glTF Y-up export of a Blender scene built in the design frame lands exactly here.
frames.yaw: design yaw_deg: 0 = facing east (+x), 90 = facing north (+y). Sim yaw_rad = radians(yaw_deg - 90).
